units.chapter_en: Eighteen questions, no. 7: a line meeting the Void
units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占求财：辰土财爻持世旬空，戌日冲之，冲空则起，本日即得

rule.yi: 旬空的爻，没有生扶又被克，到底是空；有生扶没有克，等到时候就有用。书中例：巳月戊戌日占求财，得益卦：辰土财爻持世，因为落旬空，戌日冲它，叫冲空则起，当天就得到；果然应验。应在当天，是因为戌日也是财星来冲我。这是冲空有用。
rule.en: A Void line with no life and under control is empty in the end; one with life and no control is useful when its time comes. Worked example: in the Si month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined for wealth and got Yi: the Wealth Chen-earth holds the Self and falls into the Void, and the Xu day clashes it, which is "a clash raises up the Void", so he gets it that very day; and it was borne out. It answered on the same day because the Xu day is also the Wealth star clashing me. This is a Void that is useful when clashed.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？
答曰：无生有克者到底空也，有生无克者待时用也。
卦之最凶者，喜用爻旬空；
卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。
yi: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断它到底全空，却应在填实的时候；想断成不空，却又到底是空，为什么？
回答说：没有生扶、有克的，到底是空；有生扶、没有克的，等待时候就有用。
卦最凶的，喜欢用爻旬空；
卦最好的，忌讳用爻旬空。
en: Question 7: a line meets the Void; to judge it wholly empty in the end, yet it answers when filled; to judge it not empty, yet in the end it is empty; why?
Answer: one with no life and with control is empty in the end; one with life and without control is useful when its time comes.
In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;
in the best hexagram, the Subject line being Void is feared.

zh: 巳月戊戌日占求财，得益卦：
yi: 巳月戊戌日，有人占问求财，得到益卦：
en: In the Si month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined for wealth and got Yi:

zh: 断曰：辰土财爻持世，因值旬空，戌日冲之，谓之冲空则起，本日即得。
果验。
应于本日者，戌日亦是财星冲我也。
此冲空有用是也。
yi: 断语：辰土财爻持世，因为值旬空，戌日冲它，叫冲空则起，当天就得到。
果然应验。
应在当天，是因为戌日也是财星来冲我。
这是冲空有用。
en: Judgement: the Wealth Chen-earth holds the Self and falls into the Void, and the Xu day clashes it, which is "a clash raises up the Void", so he gets it that very day.
It was borne out.
It answered on the same day because the Xu day is also the Wealth star clashing me.
This is a Void that is useful when clashed.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占仆何日回：伏午火财为用神，世空者迟至，忌神旬空待冲，旬内必到，乙巳日必回；应在巳日，是巳火也是财星，冲其飞露其伏

rule.yi: 空下的伏神容易提拔出来。书中例：亥月甲子日占仆人哪天回，得革卦：伏在下面的午火财是用神，被日月克，问吉凶就是凶；现在问哪天回来，世爻空的到得慢，忌神旬空，等到冲它，旬内一定到，乙巳日必回；后来果然应验。应在巳日，是因为巳火也是财星，冲掉飞神、显露伏神。《黄金策》说「空下伏神易于引拔」，说的就是这个。
rule.en: A hidden spirit under a Void line is easily drawn out. Worked example: in the Hai month, on a Jiazi day, a man divined on what day his servant would come back and got Ge: the hidden Wu-fire Wealth is the Subject and is controlled by the Month and the Day, so asked about luck it is ill; but asked on what day he returns, a Void Self arrives late, the Adversary is Void and waits to be clashed, so he surely comes within the ten-day period, and surely returns on the Yisi day; and afterwards it was borne out. It answered on the Si day because Si-fire is also Wealth, clashing away the flying spirit and exposing the hidden one. The Huangjin Ce says "a hidden spirit under a Void line is easily drawn out", and this is it.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？
答曰：无生有克者到底空也，有生无克者待时用也。
卦之最凶者，喜用爻旬空；
卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。
yi: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断它到底全空，却应在填实的时候；想断成不空，却又到底是空，为什么？
回答说：没有生扶、有克的，到底是空；有生扶、没有克的，等待时候就有用。
卦最凶的，喜欢用爻旬空；
卦最好的，忌讳用爻旬空。
en: Question 7: a line meets the Void; to judge it wholly empty in the end, yet it answers when filled; to judge it not empty, yet in the end it is empty; why?
Answer: one with no life and with control is empty in the end; one with life and without control is useful when its time comes.
In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;
in the best hexagram, the Subject line being Void is feared.

zh: 亥月甲子日，占仆何日回，得革卦：
yi: 亥月甲子日，占仆人哪天回，得革卦：
en: In the Hai month, on a Jiazi day, a man divined on what day his servant would come back and got Ge:

zh: 断曰：伏午火财为用神，被日月之克问其吉凶否？
凶也。
今问何日回，世空者迟至，忌神旬空待冲，旬内必到，乙巳日必回。
后果验。
验于巳日者，巳火亦是财星耳，冲其飞而露其伏也。
《黄金策》云：“空下伏神易于引拔”，此即是矣。
yi: 断语：伏在下面的午火财是用神，被日月克，问吉凶就是凶吗？
这个卦是凶的。
现在问哪天回来，世爻空的到得慢，忌神旬空，等到冲它，旬内一定到，乙巳日必回。
后来果然应验。
应在巳日，是因为巳火也是财星，冲掉飞神、显露伏神。
《黄金策》说「空下伏神易于引拔」，说的就是这个。
en: Judgement: the hidden Wu-fire Wealth is the Subject and is controlled by the Month and the Day; asked about luck, is it ill?
It is ill.
But asked on what day he returns, a Void Self arrives late, the Adversary is Void and waits to be clashed, so he surely comes within the ten-day period, and surely returns on the Yisi day.
Afterwards it was borne out.
It answered on the Si day because Si-fire is also Wealth, clashing away the flying spirit and exposing the hidden one.
The Huangjin Ce says "a hidden spirit under a Void line is easily drawn out", and this is it.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占见贵求财：亥水官星持世旬空，出旬亥日必见，月建财爻生世财利如心，应验——出空待用

rule.yi: 旬空的爻有生扶无克，等到时候就有用。书中例：申月丁卯日占谒见贵人求财，得同人卦：亥水官星持世落旬空，出了这旬到亥日一定见到；月建财爻生世，财利如意；果然应验。这是出空待用。
rule.en: A Void line with life and no control is useful when its time comes. Worked example: in the Shen month, on a Dingmao day, a man divined about seeing a noble to seek wealth and got Tongren: the Pressure Hai-water holds the Self and falls into the Void, so once the ten-day period is out he will surely see him on the Hai day; the Month and the Wealth line give life to the Self, so gain comes as hoped; and it was borne out. This is waiting for the Void to be out and then being useful.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，一人自占婚：戌土财爻旬空化巳火回头之生，动生不空，次日求必允，果于次日巳时允婚

rule.yi: 空的爻发动变出生它的爻，就不算空。书中例：子月癸酉日有人自己占婚事，得恒卦变鼎卦：世爻官、应爻财，算得地；现在戌土财爻落旬空，化出巳火回头生它，动而被生就不空，第二天去求一定答应；果然第二天巳时答应了婚事。
rule.en: A Void line that moves and changes into a line that gives it life is not counted as Void. Worked example: in the Zi month, on a Guiyou day, a man divined for his own marriage and got Heng changing to Ding: the Self is Pressure and the Other is Wealth, which counts as well placed; now the Wealth Xu-earth falls into the Void but changes into Si-fire which gives it life in return, and a line that moves and is given life is not Void, so if he asks the next day it will surely be granted; indeed the next day, in the Si hour, the marriage was agreed.

In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;

zh: 子月癸酉日，一人自占婚，得恒之鼎卦：
yi: 子月癸酉日，有人自己占婚事，得恒卦变鼎卦：
en: In the Zi month, on a Guiyou day, a man divined for his own marriage and got Heng changing to Ding:

zh: 断曰：世官应财乃云得地，今戌土财爻旬空，化巳火回头之生，动生不空，次日求之必允也。
果于次日巳时允婚。
yi: 断语：世爻官、应爻财，算得地；现在戌土财爻落旬空，化出巳火回头生它，动而被生就不空，第二天去求一定答应。
果然第二天巳时答应了婚事。

Indeed the next day, in the Si hour, the marriage was agreed.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占妻病何日愈：卯木财爻为用神旬空，亥水原神生它，次日必愈；有人说空爻应断卯日，答甲寅日卯木已出空、寅木也是用星，果然先好一日

rule.yi: 用神旬空，有原神相生，等到出空的时候。书中例：午月癸丑日占妻子的病哪天好，得萃卦变比卦：卯木财爻是用神，落旬空，有亥水原神生它，第二天一定好；旁边有人问：卯爻旬空该断卯日，为什么说寅日？我说：你不懂这个办法，到了甲寅日卯木已经出空了，寅木也是用星；果然先好了一天，应在甲寅日。
rule.en: A Subject in the Void with the Support giving it life waits until the Void is out. Worked example: in the Wu month, on a Guichou day, a man divined on what day his wife's illness would be cured and got Cui changing to Bi: the Wealth Mao-wood is the Subject and falls into the Void, with the Support Hai-water giving it life, so she will surely be better the next day. Someone beside him asked: a Void Mao line should be judged on the Mao day, so why the Yin day? I said: you do not know the method; when the Jiayin day comes Mao-wood is already out of the Void, and Yin-wood is also a star of the Subject; indeed she got better a day early, answering on the Jiayin day.

卦最好的，忌讳用爻旬空。

In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;
in the best hexagram, the Subject line being Void is feared.

zh: 午月癸丑日，占妻病何日愈，得萃之比卦：
yi: 午月癸丑日，占妻子的病哪天好，得萃卦变比卦：
en: In the Wu month, on a Guichou day, a man divined on what day his wife's illness would be cured and got Cui changing to Bi:

zh: 断曰：卯木财爻为用神，值旬空，有亥水原神相生，次日必愈。
旁有人曰：卯爻旬空宜断卯日，何言寅日？
予曰：汝不知其法，交甲寅日卯木已出空矣，寅木亦是用星耳。
果先愈一日，应甲寅日也。
yi: 断语：卯木财爻是用神，落旬空，有亥水原神生它，第二天一定好。
旁边有人说：卯爻旬空该断卯日，为什么说寅日？
我说：你不懂这个办法，到了甲寅日卯木已经出空了，寅木也是用星。
果然先好了一天，应在甲寅日。

Indeed she got better a day early, answering on the Jiayin day.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占子病何时愈：亥水子孙化寅木旬空，近病逢空即愈，但亥水化出的寅木旬空受不到酉金之生，必等寅日愈，果验——化空出空

rule.yi: 近病遇空就好，但用神化出的又是空，要等出空的日子。书中例：寅月庚戌日占儿子的病什么时候好，得姤卦变无妄卦：亥水子孙化出寅木旬空，近病遇空就好，但嫌亥水化出的寅木落旬空，受不到酉金的生，必须等寅日才好；果然应验，这是化空出空。
rule.en: A near illness meets the Void and is cured, but when what the Subject changes into is also Void, wait for the day it comes out. Worked example: in the Yin month, on a Gengxu day, a man divined when his son's illness would be cured and got Gou changing to Wuwang: the Output Hai-water changes into Yin-wood, which is Void; a near illness meeting the Void is cured, but the trouble is that Yin-wood, into which Hai-water changes, is Void and cannot receive life from You-metal, so he must wait for the Yin day; and it was borne out, a case of changing into the Void and then coming out of it.

yi: 寅月庚戌日，占儿子的病什么时候好，得姤卦变无妄卦：
en: In the Yin month, on a Gengxu day, a man divined when his son's illness would be cured and got Gou changing to Wuwang:

zh: 断曰：亥水子孙化寅木旬空，近病逢空即愈，但嫌亥水化寅木旬空，则不能受酉金之生，必等寅日愈。
果验，此化空出空也。

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占求财何日到手：未月持财月内必有，问哪天到手看卦中旬空的辰土，断辰日得财——舍未土之不空而应辰土之空

rule.yi: 旬空的爻是事情的关键所现。书中例：未月庚子日占求财哪天到手，得小畜卦：未月财爻持世，月内必定有；现在问哪天到手，卦中辰土落旬空，必定是关键所现，断辰日得财；果然应验。这是舍弃未土的不空，而应在辰土的空上。
rule.en: A Void line is where the pivot of the matter shows. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Gengzi day, a man divined on what day wealth would come into his hands and got Xiaoxu: Wealth holds the Self in the Wei month, so he will surely have it within the month; but asked on what day it comes into his hands, the Chen-earth in the hexagram falls into the Void and is surely where the pivot shows, so it was judged that he would get the wealth on the Chen day; and it was borne out. This is passing over Wei-earth that is not Void and answering on the Void Chen-earth.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？
答曰：无生有克者到底空也，有生无克者待时用也。

卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。

zh: 未月庚子日，占求财何日到手，得小畜卦：
yi: 未月庚子日，占求财哪天到手，得小畜卦：
en: In the Wei month, on a Gengzi day, a man divined on what day wealth would come into his hands and got Xiaoxu:

zh: 断曰：未月持财，月内必有。
今问何日到手，卦中辰土旬空，必关因所现也。
断其辰日得财，果验。
此乃舍未土之不空而应辰土之空也。
yi: 断语：未月财爻持世，月内必定有。
现在问哪天到手，卦中辰土落旬空，必定是关键所现。
断辰日得财，果然应验。
这是舍弃未土的不空，而应在辰土的空上。
en: Judgement: Wealth holds the Self in the Wei month, so he will surely have it within the month.
But asked on what day it comes into his hands, the Chen-earth in the hexagram falls into the Void and is surely where the pivot shows.
It was judged that he would get the wealth on the Chen day, and it was borne out.
This is passing over Wei-earth that is not Void and answering on the Void Chen-earth.

Asked on what day the danger falls, I said: Wu-fire itself changes into the Void, and a Void cannot control it; a near illness meeting the Void does not die, and he will not die within the ten-day period, so guard against the Yiyou day; indeed he died on the Yiyou day in the Mao hour.

zh: 酉月庚辰日占岳父近病，得师之升卦：
yi: 酉月庚辰日，占岳父的近病，得师卦变升卦：
en: In the You month, on a Gengchen day, a man divined about his father-in-law's recent illness and got Shi changing to Sheng:

zh: 断曰：酉金岳父旬空，近病逢空即愈；

问曰：危于何日？
答曰：午火自化旬空，旬空不能克之，近病逢空不死，旬内不死，乙酉日防之。
果于乙酉日卯时而死矣！

Indeed he died on the Yiyou day in the Mao hour!

rule.en: A hidden spirit not lifted up is in vain in the end. Worked example: in the You month, on a Renchen day, a man divined about his son's illness and got Daguo: the Output Wu-fire is hidden under the Self line Hai-water; the Month gives it life and Hai-water controls it; for now the Subject is Void and is not hurt by the control, but on the Jiawu day he cannot escape; and indeed he died on the Wu day in the Wu hour, which is what is meant by a hidden spirit with no lift.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？
答曰：无生有克者到底空也，有生无克者待时用也。
卦之最凶者，喜用爻旬空；
卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。
yi: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断它到底全空，却应在填实的时候；想断成不空，却又到底是空，为什么？
回答说：没有生扶、有克的，到底是空；有生扶、没有克的，等待时候就有用。

zh: 酉月壬辰日占子病，得大过卦：
yi: 酉月壬辰日，占儿子的病，得大过卦：
en: In the You month, on a Renchen day, a man divined about his son's illness and got Daguo:

zh: 断曰：午火子孙伏世亥水之下，月建生助，亥水克之，目下用神旬空不受其克，甲午日难逃矣！
果死于午日午时，此谓伏无提拔也。
yi: 断语：午火子孙伏在世爻亥水之下，月建生助它，亥水克它，眼下用神落旬空不受克，到甲午日难逃了！

en: Judgement: the Output Wu-fire is hidden under the Self line Hai-water; the Month gives it life and Hai-water controls it; for now the Subject is Void and is not hurt by the control, but on the Jiawu day he cannot escape!

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占弟死太湖尸首可见否：占尸首以鬼爻为用神，寅木鬼旬空、亥水得令暗动合它，尸首在大水之中，被合须待出旬逢冲，断庚申日可见；没见到，到丑月甲子旬壬申日才浮起——寅鬼出旬而亥水大旺，丑土制水，亥水旬空如水退，木在水中非冲不起

rule.yi: 用神旬空被合，要等出旬逢冲。书中例：子月乙巳日有人占弟弟死在太湖，尸首能不能见到，得复卦：占尸首以鬼爻为用神，现在寅木爻落旬空，而亥水是得令之水，暗动去合它，分明尸首在大水之中；但寅木旬空被合，必须等出旬逢冲，庚申日可以见到；后来到庚申日没有见到，直到丑月甲子旬内的壬申日，尸首浮起才见到，为什么？总之寅鬼出旬后亥水大旺，到了丑月丑土制水，甲子旬里亥水旬空，水空就像水退了；木在水中不冲就浮不起来，所以应验在甲子旬壬申日，岂不是神灵的奇报？学的人不能不深究。
rule.en: A Subject in the Void and combined shut must wait for the ten-day period to be out and then be clashed. Worked example: in the Zi month, on a Yisi day, a man divined whether the body of his brother, who had died in Lake Tai, could be seen, and got Fu: in divining for a body the Pressure line is the Subject; now the Yin-wood line falls into the Void, while Hai-water is water in command and secretly moves to combine it, so the body is plainly in deep water; but Yin-wood is Void and combined shut, and must wait for the period to be out and then be clashed, so it can be seen on the Gengshen day; afterwards it was not seen on the Gengshen day, and only on the Renshen day within the Jiazi decade in the Chou month did the body float up and was found; why? In short, after Yin Pressure came out of the Void Hai-water was very strong, and when the Chou month came Chou-earth held the water in check, and in the Jiazi decade Hai-water is Void, and Void water is like water that has receded; wood in water does not float without a clash, so it was borne out on the Renshen day of the Jiazi decade; is this not a wondrous report from the spirits? The student must study it deeply.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？

卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。

卦最好的，忌讳用爻旬空。

In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;
in the best hexagram, the Subject line being Void is feared.

zh: 子月乙巳日，一人占弟死太湖，尸首可见否，得复卦：
yi: 子月乙巳日，有人占弟弟死在太湖，尸首能不能见到，得复卦：
en: In the Zi month, on a Yisi day, a man divined whether the body of his brother, who had died in Lake Tai, could be seen, and got Fu:

zh: 断曰：凡占尸首以鬼爻为用神，今寅木爻旬空，而亥水乃得令之水，暗动合之，明明尸首在于大水之中矣。
但寅木旬空，被合须待出旬逢冲，庚申日可见。
后至庚申日不见，直至丑月甲子旬内壬申日，尸首浮起得见，此意何也？
总之寅鬼出旬而亥水大旺，交丑建丑土制水，甲子旬亥水旬空，水空者如水退矣；
木在水中非冲不起，故验于甲子旬壬申日也，岂非神之奇报？
学者不可不深究之。
yi: 断语：凡是占尸首以鬼爻为用神，现在寅木爻落旬空，而亥水是得令之水，暗动去合它，分明尸首在大水之中。

But Yin-wood is Void and combined shut, and must wait for the period to be out and then be clashed, so it can be seen on the Gengshen day.
Afterwards it was not seen on the Gengshen day, and only on the Renshen day within the Jiazi decade in the Chou month did the body float up and was found; why?

In short, after Yin Pressure came out of the Void Hai-water was very strong, and when the Chou month came Chou-earth held the water in check, and in the Jiazi decade Hai-water is Void, and Void water is like water that has receded;
wood in water does not float without a clash, so it was borne out on the Renshen day of the Jiazi decade; is this not a wondrous report from the spirits?
The student must study it deeply.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占父近病：巳火父母为用神旬空，日辰拱它，近病逢空不死，但不利六合卦、六合即死；世上忌神暗动、外卦巳酉丑合成金局助水克它，此病必凶，危于出旬辛亥日，果至其日死——出旬又被冲克

rule.yi: 近病遇空不死，遇六合就死。书中例：丑月甲午日有人占父亲的近病，得复卦变噬嗑卦：巳火父母是用神，落旬空，日辰拱它，近病遇空不死，但不利六合卦，六合就死；我想用神空和六合可以相抵，偏偏不宜世上忌神暗动，外卦巳酉丑合成金局去助水克它，此病必凶；他问：凶在哪天？我说：巳日亥日克冲巳火，还在旬空里没有妨碍，恐怕危险在出旬的辛亥日；果然到那天死了，这是应在出旬又被冲克。
rule.en: A near illness meeting the Void does not die, and meeting a six-combine dies. Worked example: in the Chou month, on a Jiawu day, a man divined about his father's recent illness and got Fu changing to Shihe: the Resource Si-fire is the Subject and falls into the Void, with the Day embracing it; a near illness meeting the Void does not die, but a six-combine hexagram is unfavourable, and a six-combine means death. I thought the Void Subject and the six-combine could offset each other, but what is unfit is the Adversary on the Self line moving secretly, and the outer trigram Si, You and Chou combining into a Metal frame that helps the water to control it, so this illness is surely ill. He asked: on what day does the ill fall? I said: on a Si or a Hai day it is controlled or clashed, but while it is still in the Void there is no harm; I fear the danger lies on the Xinhai day when it comes out of the ten-day period; and indeed he died that day. This is answering at coming out of the period and being clashed and controlled.

卦最好的，忌讳用爻旬空。

In the most ill hexagram, the Subject line being Void is welcome;
in the best hexagram, the Subject line being Void is feared.

zh: 丑月甲午日，一人占父近病，得复之噬嗑卦：
yi: 丑月甲午日，有人占父亲的近病，得复卦变噬嗑卦：
en: In the Chou month, on a Jiawu day, a man divined about his father's recent illness and got Fu changing to Shihe:

zh: 断曰：巳火父母为用神，值旬空，日辰拱之，近病逢空不死，但不利六合卦，六合即死。
予想用空六合可以相敌，独不宜世上忌神暗动，外卦巳酉丑合成金局助水克之，此病必凶。
彼曰：凶在何日？
答曰：巳亥日克冲巳火，还在旬空不妨，恐危于出旬辛亥日也。
果至其日而死。

I said: on a Si or a Hai day it is controlled or clashed, but while it is still in the Void there is no harm; I fear the danger lies on the Xinhai day when it comes out of the ten-day period.
And indeed he died that day.
This is answering at coming out of the period and being clashed and controlled.

units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，大旱占何日有雨：月建未土父母爻为用神，日辰帮比，有雨必大；巳火官爻原神旬空安静，静必冲、空必待出旬，断辛亥日大雨，果至其日申酉时得雨五寸

rule.yi: 原神旬空安静，要等出旬逢冲。书中例：未月戊戌日因大旱占哪天有雨，得观卦：月建未土父母爻是用神，日辰帮扶，有雨一定大；但巳火官爻是原神，落旬空安静，静了必须冲它，空了必须等出旬；断辛亥日得大雨；果然到那天申酉时得雨五寸。
rule.en: A Support that is Void and still must wait for the period to be out and then be clashed. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined on what day there would be rain in a great drought and got Guan: the Resource line Wei-earth of the Month is the Subject, with the Day helping it, so the rain will surely be heavy; but the Pressure Si-fire is the Support, Void and still, and being still it must be clashed and being Void it must wait for the period to be out; it was judged that heavy rain would come on the Xinhai day; and on that day, in the Shen and You hours, five inches of rain fell.

zh: 第七问：爻遇旬空，断乎到底全空，却应乎填实，欲断作不空，却又到底空，何也？
答曰：无生有克者到底空也，有生无克者待时用也。
卦之最凶者，喜用爻旬空；
卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。

zh: 未月戊戌，因大旱占何日有雨，得观卦：
yi: 未月戊戌日，因为大旱占哪天有雨，得观卦：
en: In the Wei month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined on what day there would be rain in a great drought and got Guan:

zh: 断曰：月建未土父母爻为用神，日辰帮比，有雨必大；
但巳火官爻为原神，值旬空安静，静必冲，空必待出旬。
断辛亥日得大雨。
果至其日申酉时得雨五寸。
yi: 断语：月建未土父母爻是用神，日辰帮扶，有雨一定大；
但巳火官爻是原神，落旬空安静，静了必须冲它，空了必须等出旬。
断辛亥日得大雨。
果然到那天申酉时下了五寸雨。
en: Judgement: the Resource line Wei-earth of the Month is the Subject, with the Day helping it, so the rain will surely be heavy;
but the Pressure Si-fire is the Support, Void and still, and being still it must be clashed and being Void it must wait for the period to be out.
It was judged that heavy rain would come on the Xinhai day.
And on that day, in the Shen and You hours, five inches of rain fell.

rule.yi: 旬空的爻被日辰冲起，要等到相应的日子。书中例：未月戊戌日占交情疏远的人哪天来，得蹇卦：凡是占至交朋友以兄弟爻为用神，现在占交情疏远的人，应当以应爻为用神；现在应爻落旬空，得日辰冲起，必须等甲辰日到；果然应验。
rule.en: A Void line clashed into motion by the Day waits for the corresponding day. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined on what day a casual acquaintance would come and got Jian: in divining for an intimate friend the Peer line is the Subject, but now divining for a casual acquaintance the Other line should be the Subject; now the Other line falls into the Void and is clashed into motion by the Day, so he must wait for the Jiachen day; and it was borne out.

zh: 未月戊戌日，占交疏之人何日来，得蹇卦：
yi: 未月戊戌日，占交情疏远的人哪天来，得蹇卦：
en: In the Wei month, on a Wuxu day, a man divined on what day a casual acquaintance would come and got Jian:

zh: 断曰：凡卜至交之朋友，以兄弟为用神，今卜交疏之人，当以应爻为用。
今应爻旬空，得日辰冲起，必待甲辰日到。
果验。
yi: 断语：凡是占至交的朋友，以兄弟爻为用神，现在占交情疏远的人，应当以应爻为用神。
现在应爻落旬空，得日辰冲起，必须等甲辰日到。

units.chapter: 十八问答·第七问·爻遇旬空
units.chapter_en: Eighteen questions, no. 7: a line meeting the Void
units.title: 十八问答·第七问·书中例，占何日有大雨：辰土父母发动月建帮之土旺，得雨必大，但化卯木旬空回头克，卯木出空值日（乙卯日）才下，至期竟无，到立秋辛酉申时才雨——卯木出空到底被克不尽，交申月克之、酉日冲之方得雨

rule.yi: 用神被空爻回头克，要等那个空爻出空，还要看克它的是谁。书中例：未月甲辰日占哪天有大雨，得小过卦变革卦：日辰辰土父母爻是用神，发动，月建帮它，又值土旺用事，辰土旺得没法说，下雨一定不小；但不宜化出卯木旬空、卯木回头之克；虽然有申金化出酉金进神克木救土，可是卯木旬空，空叫做畏避，躲开金的克，以致辰土父爻终究被卯木所病；必定到甲寅旬乙卯日卯木出空值日，叫出头难避，戌土暗动助金克它；而卯木已经受金克，不能为害辰土，必定等甲寅旬乙卯日下雨。到期竟然没有，到立秋辛酉日申时才下雨。应在立秋后的酉日，为什么？明显是申化酉，就是申月酉日。卯木出空值日到底被克不尽，交申月克它，酉日又冲它，才得下雨。我因为这一卦，学问又进了一层！
rule.en: A Subject struck by the turning-back control of a Void line must wait for that Void line to come out, and one must also look at who controls it. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Jiachen day, a man divined on what day there would be heavy rain and got Xiaoguo changing to Ge: the Resource line Chen-earth of the Day is the Subject, moving, helped by the Month, and Earth is also ruling, so Chen-earth is strong beyond words and the rain will surely not be small; but it is unfit that it changes into Mao-wood, which is Void, with the turning-back control of Mao-wood; though Shen-metal changes into You-metal as an Advancing spirit to control Wood and rescue Earth, Mao-wood is Void, and being Void is called taking shelter, avoiding the control of Metal, so that Chen-earth, the Resource line, is in the end made ill by Mao-wood; it must come to the Yimao day of the Jiayin decade, when Mao-wood comes out of the Void and rules, which is called coming out into the open and hard to avoid; Xu-earth secretly moves to help Metal control it; and since Mao-wood is already controlled by Metal it cannot harm Chen-earth, so it must wait for the Yimao day of the Jiayin decade for rain. At the appointed time there was none, and only on the Xinyou day of the beginning of autumn, in the Shen hour, did rain fall. Why does it answer on a You day after the beginning of autumn? Plainly Shen changes into You, which is the Shen month and a You day. Mao-wood coming out of the Void and ruling was in the end not wholly controlled; the Shen month controls it and the You day clashes it, and only then did the rain fall. Through this hexagram my learning went up another level!

zh: 未月甲辰日，卜何日有大雨，得小过之革卦：
yi: 未月甲辰日，占哪天有大雨，得小过卦变革卦：
en: In the Wei month, on a Jiachen day, a man divined on what day there would be heavy rain and got Xiaoguo changing to Ge:

zh: 断曰：日辰辰土父母爻为用神，发动，月建帮之，又值土王用事，其辰土旺莫胜言，得雨决不小也；
但不宜化卯木旬空，化卯木回头之克。
虽有申金化酉金进神克木救土，而卯木旬空，空则谓之畏避，避金之克，致辰土父爻终成病于卯木也。
必至甲寅旬乙卯日卯木出空值日，谓之出头难避，戌土暗动助金克之；
而卯木已受金克，不能为害辰土，必待甲寅旬乙卯日有雨也。
至期竟无，至立秋辛酉申时方雨。
应于立秋后酉日者，何也？
明现申化酉，即申月酉日也。
卯木出空值日到底被克不尽，交申月克之，酉日又冲之，方始得雨。
予因此卦，学问又进一层矣！
yi: 断语：日辰辰土父母爻是用神，发动，月建帮它，又值土旺用事，辰土旺得没法说，下雨一定不小；
但不宜化出卯木旬空、卯木回头之克。
虽然有申金化出酉金进神克木救土，可是卯木旬空，空叫做畏避，躲开金的克，以致辰土父爻终究被卯木所病；
必定到甲寅旬乙卯日卯木出空值日，叫出头难避，戌土暗动助金克它；
而卯木已经受金克，不能为害辰土，必定等甲寅旬乙卯日下雨。
到期竟然没有，到立秋辛酉日申时才下雨。

明显是申化酉，就是申月酉日。

我因为这一卦，学问又进了一层！

but it is unfit that it changes into Mao-wood, which is Void, with the turning-back control of Mao-wood.

Though Shen-metal changes into You-metal as an Advancing spirit to control Wood and rescue Earth, Mao-wood is Void, and being Void is called taking shelter, avoiding the control of Metal, so that Chen-earth, the Resource line, is in the end made ill by Mao-wood;

it must come to the Yimao day of the Jiayin decade, when Mao-wood comes out of the Void and rules, which is called coming out into the open and hard to avoid; Xu-earth secretly moves to help Metal control it;
and since Mao-wood is already controlled by Metal it cannot harm Chen-earth, so it must wait for the Yimao day of the Jiayin decade for rain.
At the appointed time there was none, and only on the Xinyou day of the beginning of autumn, in the Shen hour, did rain fall.
Why does it answer on a You day after the beginning of autumn?
Plainly Shen changes into You, which is the Shen month and a You day.
Mao-wood coming out of the Void and ruling was in the end not wholly controlled; the Shen month controls it and the You day clashes it, and only then did the rain fall.
Through this hexagram my learning went up another level!
